reason: This plugin is a sidebar UI extension that presents API quota/balance information to users inside DSH Web, with a host-served endpoint that queries a DeepSeek balance API on behalf of the browser UI, so its primary user-facing purpose is navigation-panel based quota visibility.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DSH Web 侧边栏新增“API 配额”入口，点击后通过插件主机代理获取 DeepSeek 余额数据，并在弹出的面板中展示账户余额信息。
summaries.en: This plugin adds an API Quota entry to the DSH Web sidebar, then opens a panel to display DeepSeek balance information fetched through a plugin-host endpoint.

reasons.code: Host registers GET /api-quota/balance and resolves DeepSeek API key through ctx.credentials before querying https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance.
Browser side adds a sidebar footer action and opens a modal panel showing total/granted/topped-up balance and query time.
Plugin exposes apiKeyEnv, baseURL, and balancePath configuration fields for API endpoint and credential reference setup.
